label: FIXTURE RESULT: Stage 5 evaluation (recorded window, frozen bundle)

attempts.validity: logs COMPLETE, timings COMPLETE, handler max 255.097 ms, failures 0

report.summary: Outbox publications (3.13/s) trail committed arrivals (3.61/s) because each delivery takes ~326 ms in the consumer, so a backlog builds and notifications are delayed. Serial delivery is inferred, not observed.

findings.claim: Outbox publishes slower than events arrive; pending climbed from 3 to as much as 148 during the window.
findings.reason: Arrivals 3.606/s vs publications 3.133/s (85 behind); pending grew 3→32→70→111 before the final catch-up buckets.

findings.claim: Each delivery takes ~326 ms, almost all of it in the consumer (auth ~70 ms, handler ~255 ms); LedgerCore adds ~1 ms.
findings.reason: Timings are uniform (p50 326 ms, p95 328 ms); all 565 attempts succeeded with status 200.

findings.claim: The slow per-delivery time probably caps throughput near 3/s (~1/0.326 s), below the arrival rate, which would explain the growing backlog.
findings.reason: If batches of 20 are delivered serially, ~3.07/s matches the observed 3.13/s publication rate.

limitations: Serial delivery inside a batch was not directly observed; the poller's concurrency was not inspected.
The consumer is a test fixture, so its ~326 ms latency may not reflect production; the 778 old failed rows were not investigated.
next_checks: Inspect the outbox poller code and a thread dump to confirm whether deliveries within a batch run sequentially.
Re-run with a faster consumer or parallel delivery and check whether publications keep up with arrivals.

alternatives.reason: Zero pool waits or timeouts, no blocking sampled, and the transfers route was fast with no server errors.
alternatives.hypothesis: DB pool exhaustion or lock blocking delayed the outbox or the API

alternatives.reason: All attempts succeeded; the failed count was flat at 778, and the very old undelivered age points to a stale pre-existing row.
alternatives.hypothesis: Delivery failures and retries are causing the delay
